jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON SOLID PERFUME 4.3GR (0.14 OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
A solid perfume featuring the Fashionably London scent, perfect for carrying with you and reapplying at any time of day. Pair it with the Eau de Parfum for an elevated olfactory experience. Inspired by the relaxed sophistication of London, this fragrance blends the luminous freshness of bergamot with the modern femininity of rose and the enveloping softness of musk.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Floral musk | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary
